text:
I see that many couples life change after a baby, mainly cos baby change the relationship dynamic in all sphere of life, which is not always smooth, specially when the partner ( mostly men) do not try to understand the actual situation. For women, it starts with post partum hormonal changes, and for both, less night sleeps cos baby need feeding, and so on, if it’s the woman that takes care of the baby ( breastfeeding and taking maternity from work ) then the world also becomes very small. 

And in your case, you are not Israeli, and I guess you also not have family here, which made it all the more not easy. And the language barrier and cultural barrier, which will made it hard to open up to other mom, though many Israeli moms are warm and nice. 

Even if you are not a foreign woman, many couple ( my guess most couple ) have issues once the baby is there. It was in my case too, no job, new in the country, no family, my husband do not really understand fully what I went thru ( to give birth/ the physical and emotional experience/ hormones ) and the sudden home chore increase as baby are dependent and needy and that I need help in the house, which add the stress. Personally, after a few ‘kicks’ and lot of explanation and requests, he starts to see my point to view and how I need ‘help’ and support. 

Maybe it’s worth to talk to him, think about next step like putting the baby to gan from this September and you will start looking for a work and contribute the income. And / or putting the baby one or two nights or a weekend to his family ( grandparents) so both of you can have a date night or weekend away so you can have a heart to heart talk and also a private time together without the baby? Or you can even take the baby (?) 

If you see there is a glimpse of line that can be save, why not try it ? Do you think it’s worth it? Think about it. Or you already thought and did all of these and failed. (?) 

Once kids are involved it’s usually hard to leave the country. I hope someone else will guide you in the right direction regarding this. 💙
